modules.title: 版本 v2 出现异常后怎样切回已知可用的 v1
回滚成功要看两份证据

items.title: 先恢复已知可用状态以缩小影响
items.text: 当新版本造成明显用户影响时，切回已验证的版本或配置能快速停止扩散。回滚目标应明确，不能只说“恢复一下”而不知道回的是哪一份版本。

items.title: 切换完成不等于健康恢复
items.text: 回滚后先确认实际运行版本已经变回目标版本，再看登录成功率、错误率或关键操作是否恢复。若指标未恢复，问题可能不只在这次版本。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 回滚不是修好代码后再发布一个新版本，那叫向前修复。它也不同于关闭功能开关：开关只停用一条新路径，回滚会恢复整个版本或配置到先前状态。

lessonPractice.title: v2 发布后登录错误率升高，团队把镜像切回 v1。接下来哪项才算完成回滚验证？

options.label: 确认线上实际运行 v1，并确认登录错误率和登录成功结果恢复
options.feedback: 对。既要证明切换目标已运行，也要证明用户受影响的信号已恢复。

options.label: 命令显示成功就结束，不需要看线上指标
options.feedback: 命令成功不保证流量已经用到目标版本，也不保证异常已经消失。

options.label: 立刻开始修 v2，不再关心当前线上状态
options.feedback: 向前修复可以后续进行，但当前需要先证实影响已经被止住。

en.title: After v2 raises login error rate, the team switches the image back to v1. What completes rollback verification?

options.label: Confirm production is actually running v1 and that login error rate and login success recover
options.feedback: Correct. Prove both that the target is running and that the user-impact signal recovered.

options.label: End when the command reports success, without checking production metrics
options.feedback: A successful command does not guarantee traffic uses the target version or the anomaly disappeared.

options.label: Immediately start fixing v2 and ignore the current live state
options.feedback: A forward fix can follow, but first prove the present impact has stopped.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 若登录错误率超过阈值，请把生产从 v2 回滚到上一个已知可用的 v1。完成后同时确认实际运行版本是 v1，且登录错误率和成功率恢复；把两项证据告诉我。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: If login error rate crosses its threshold, roll production back from v2 to the last known-good v1. Afterward, confirm both that v1 is actually running and that login error and success rates recovered; report both pieces of evidence.

learning.assumes: You know a release can create a problem that needs immediate impact reduction.
learning.outcome: You can distinguish rollback from a forward fix and require both version and health signals as rollback evidence.

modules.title: How abnormal v2 returns to known-good v1
Rollback success needs two kinds of evidence

items.title: Restore a known-good state to reduce impact
items.text: When a new version materially affects people, returning to a verified version or configuration can stop spread quickly. State the target clearly rather than saying only “restore it.”

items.title: A completed switch is not recovered health
items.text: First confirm the target version is actually running, then inspect login success, error rate, or key action recovery. If metrics do not recover, the problem may extend beyond this version.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Rollback is not fixing code and shipping another version; that is a forward fix. It also differs from disabling a feature flag: a flag stops one new path, while rollback restores a whole version or configuration to a prior state.

distinctions.label: Feature flag
distinctions.text: {c:rollback} restores a system or configuration to a previously known-good state. A {c:feature-flag} can disable one code path without necessarily changing the deployed version.
